Metadata.title: Dr. Buket Bayram | Dermatologist
Metadata.description: Learn about dermatology, dermocosmetic procedures and laser treatments in Üsküdar, and request an appointment via WhatsApp.

Navigation.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to get information about an appointment.

Home.description: A calm and balanced specialist approach spanning medical dermatology and dermocosmetic care for skin, hair and nail health.
Home.heroImageAlt: A dermatologist carefully assessing an adult patient's skin in a bright consultation room
Home.servicesTitle: A complete perspective on skin health.
Home.servicesDescription: Medical dermatology, dermocosmetic and laser services are planned around your skin's needs after a specialist evaluation.
Home.medicalDescription: Specialist examination for skin, hair and nail concerns, with individualized evaluation and follow-up when needed.
Home.cosmeticDescription: A measured, physician-led approach that considers skin health, appearance and natural balance together.
Home.laserDescription: Controlled, individualized laser procedures planned according to skin needs and a personal suitability assessment.

botox.title: Botox
botox.description: A measured, individual plan based on facial movement, muscle activity and a physician's assessment.

fullFaceFiller.title: Full-face filler treatments
fullFaceFiller.description: Balanced, gradual filler planning that considers facial proportions as a whole rather than as isolated areas.

lipFiller.title: Lip filler
lipFiller.description: A personal approach that considers lip shape, movement and facial proportions while preserving a natural appearance.

mesotherapy.title: Mesotherapy & skin rejuvenation
mesotherapy.description: Supportive treatments shaped by a physician's assessment of the skin's hydration, vitality and texture needs.

prp.title: PRP
prp.description: A regenerative approach using plasma prepared from the patient's own blood after an individual suitability assessment.

skinBooster.title: Skin Booster & Profhilo
skinBooster.description: Treatment options planned around individual needs to support the skin's hydration balance and overall quality.

polynucleotide.title: Polynucleotide / Salmon DNA
polynucleotide.description: A care plan personalised by treatment area, skin structure and expectations to support overall skin quality.

hifu.title: HIFU facial rejuvenation
hifu.description: A non-surgical approach using focused ultrasound, planned around facial anatomy and individual needs.

fractionalLaser.title: Fractional laser
fractionalLaser.description: A controlled laser treatment that addresses skin texture and the appearance of scars after specialist assessment.

laserHairRemoval.title: Laser hair removal
laserHairRemoval.description: A treatment process with device, energy and session planning tailored to the individual's hair and skin type.

pigmentation.title: Pigmentation treatments
pigmentation.description: A process in which treatment options may be combined after assessing the type, depth and cause of pigmentation.

skinRenewal.title: Skin renewal
skinRenewal.description: Individual planning that brings together medical skin-care options according to texture, tone and hydration needs.

acne.title: Acne & acne-scar treatments
acne.description: A staged approach that evaluates active acne and scar appearance separately according to the individual's skin type.

bodyContouring.title: Targeted body contouring
bodyContouring.description: A personal plan developed with suitable methods after assessing body structure, the target area and expectations.

bodyFirming.title: Body firming
bodyFirming.description: A supportive approach planned with energy-based options according to tissue quality and treatment area.

celluliteStretchMarks.title: Cellulite & stretch-mark treatments
celluliteStretchMarks.description: A personal process using individual or combined methods according to tissue structure and visible concerns.

hairMesotherapy.title: Hair mesotherapy & hair PRP
hairMesotherapy.description: Supportive treatments planned around scalp needs after investigating the underlying cause of hair loss.

neckDecolleteHands.title: Neck, décolleté & hand rejuvenation
neckDecolleteHands.description: A care plan that evaluates the texture, hydration and pigmentation needs of these delicate areas separately.

sweatingBotox.title: Botox for excessive sweating
sweatingBotox.description: A botulinum toxin treatment planned after evaluating the affected area and individual suitability.

Home.approachDescription: The website provides general information; personal diagnosis and treatment planning can only take shape through a specialist physician evaluation.
Home.approachStepOneDescription: Your concern, expectations, skin history and everyday routine are considered together.
Home.approachStepTwoDescription: Skin, hair or nail needs are assessed from a dermatologist's perspective and suitable options are explained.
Home.approachStepThreeDescription: The process is planned in a clear, measured and trackable way according to personal needs and suitability.
Home.aboutSpecialty: An approach that brings medical dermatology and dermocosmetic procedures together on the same specialist foundation.
Home.aboutDescription: Dr. Buket Bayram graduated from Samsun 19 Mayıs University Faculty of Medicine and completed her dermatology residency at Istanbul Göztepe SSK Training and Research Hospital. Her professional approach combines current dermatology knowledge with clear communication and balanced treatment planning.
Home.aboutPrinciple: Every skin has different needs; its evaluation should be personal too.
